args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP. This aligns the implementation with the spec and fixes
the nightly failure in tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` claimed to implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) in its docstring, but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- This change aligns the implementation with the spec by importing and using `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Why
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects `2.665 → 2.66` (banker's rounding), which `ROUND_HALF_UP` does not produce.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed (https://example.com/ci/ci-0001).
